findings.title: Test file will not pass the project's strict type check as configured
findings.why: It imports "./index.ts" with an explicit .ts extension. `tsconfig.json` uses NodeNext with no `allowImportingTsExtensions`, no `noEmit` and no `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions`. Its `include` of `src` covers the test file, so `tsc` should reject that import (TS5097). The test file also imports `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`, and `src/index.ts` uses `structuredClone`. `package.json` has no `@types/node` and `tsconfig.json` sets no `lib`, so those would not type-check either. The task Outcome notes admit the strict type check was never run. I did not run `tsc`; this comes from reading the config.

findings.title: Four plan documents are committed as unfilled scaffolds
findings.why: `sw-life-cycle-1-2-plan.md` through `sw-life-cycle-1-5-plan.md` contain only the template placeholder comment. Their `element` and `parent` fields are empty and `status` is still `active`. The scaffold text itself says the author must fill the fields and replace the comments before submitting. They add noise and carry no plan content.
